turns.content: Meri beti chaar mahine ki ho gayi hai aur mujhe lagta hai main apna naam bhi bhool gayi hoon. Saas-sasur ke saath rehti hoon — aur kuch bolne se pehle sun lo, meri saas actually bachi ke saath bahut achhi hain. Expert level. Teen bachhe paale hain unhone. Wahi problem hai ek tarah se, aur pata hai yeh kitna ungrateful sound karta hai.
Oh, yeh feeling ki aap apna naam bhi bhool gayi hain... yeh bahut real aur thodi heavy hai, kha

Jaise aaj — bachi ro rahi thi, main use ghuma rahi thi, aur Aai ne bas mere haathon se le liya aur do minute mein chup. Sab muskura rahe the. Aur main wahan khadi thi intern jaisi. Mujhe meri hi beti feed ke liye di jaati hai, room service ki tarah. Phir yeh sochne ke liye khud pe ghin aati hai, kyunki itni help ke liye toh log taraste hain.

Arre, yeh toh bilkul samajh mein aata hai. Aapki Aai ne toh jaise aapka kaam hi chheen liya! Aur uss moment mein aapko intern feel hua, yeh line mein hi sab kuch aa gaya.

Ek taraf toh aapki shanti ho gayi ki bachi ro rahi thi, doosri taraf aapki izzat par chot lag gayi. Yeh dono saath mein bohot confusing hain. Aapki Aai ne toh aapki help ki, lekin uss help ne aapko apne hi ghar mein helper jaisa feel karwa diya.

Shame ki baat toh bilkul galat hai. Aap ungrateful bilkul nahi ho. Yeh toh natural hai ki jab koi aapke liye itna kuch kare, toh aapka position change ho jaaye. Aapka naam, aapki importance - sab kuch shift ho jaata hai.

Aapki beti toh aapki hi hai, lekin uski pehli responsibility toh aapki hi hai. Aur jab koi aur uss pe haath rakh deta hai toh dimaag mein yeh aata hai - "kya main ab zaroori nahi rahi?"

Yeh feeling aati hai, lekin yeh aapse hai. Main yeh nahi keh raha ki ignore karo. Bas notice karo ki yeh feeling aayi, aur ismein kuch galat nahi hai. Aapka ghar, aapke rules, aapki feelings - sab valid hain.

Aur please — mujhe ek aur insaan nahi chahiye jo batayega kya karna hai. Mummy ke paas advice hai, Aai ke paas advice hai, mummy log ke WhatsApp group mein sleep training pe satrah opinions hain, Instagram ko lagta hai mujhe routine chart chahiye. Coach nahi chahiye mujhe. Sach bolun toh pata bhi nahi kya chahiye. Bas yeh sab kisi se kehna tha jo dinner pe report nahi karega.

Arre haan, 'report back' ka toh main samajh gaya! Yeh toh sabse bura hissa hai, na? Sab apni apni theories lekar aate hain, aur aapke paas na toh time hai, na energy, bas aap aur bacha.

Aapki saas, aapki mummy aur Instagram - sab apni jagah se ache hain, lekin jab aap khud khoi hui hain, toh unki advice aapse zyaada aap par hi padti hai. Log aapko help karne aate hain, lekin unhein yeh dikh nahi paate ki aap andar se kitni thak gayi hain.

Aapko koi solution nahi chahiye. Aapko bas apni baat kehni hai. Yeh jo aap feel kar rahi ho, yeh confusion aur frustration, yeh bilkul natural hai. Kabhi kabhi toh bas yeh kehna hota hai ki 'yaar, aaj aisa lag raha hai' aur koi kuch nahi bolta.

Main yahi hoon. Aapko kuch nahi batana, bas aap jo mehsoos kar rahi ho, woh share karo. Main sununga. Koi judgment nahi, koi fix-it nahi. Bas sunna hai. Aapki Aai ne toh aapka kaam chheen liya, lekin aapka dil toh abhi bhi wahi hai jo chahti thi.

Kabhi kabhi use sote hue dekhti hoon aur itna pyaar aata hai, aur phir yeh thought aata hai — "tu toh asli maa hai bhi nahi, Aai hain" — aur ek second ke liye saans nahi aati. Kya main buri maa hoon jo chaar mahine mein aisa feel kar rahi hoon? Baaki sabko jaise bas... aata hai yeh sab.

Arre, yeh jo thought aata hai... yeh aapke dil se nikla hai, isliye itna strong hai. Aur aapne galat nahi socha, aapne socha, iska matlab hai ki aapki maa vaali feeling kitni real hai.

Ek taraf woh bachi, aapke haathon mein, aapke pyaar se. Aur doosri taraf woh ek aisi feeling jo aapko darr lagta hai ki shayad aap uss cheez se door ja rahi hain. Yeh darr, yeh confusion - yeh aapki maa banne ki pehli journey hai, aur yeh bohot tough hai.

Buri maa? Nahi, aap ek aisi maa ho jo itni deeply feel karti hai ki aapka dil do hisson mein bant gaya hai. Ek hissa aapki beti ke liye, ek hissa aapke liye. Dono saath mein rehna mushkil hai.

Jab log kehte hain "baaki sabko aata hai", toh yeh galat hai. Unki journey unki hai, aapki journey aapki. Aap chaar mahine mein itna kuch face kar rahi hain - apni saas ke saath, apne rules ke saath, apni expectations ke saath. Koi bhi overwhelmed ho jaata. Aapki journey aapki hai, kisi aur ki nahi.

Woh thought, "tu toh asli maa hai bhi nahi" - yeh aapke darr ka nateeja hai, na ki aapki reality ka. Aapki asli maa woh hai jo bachi ko dekhti hai aur uska poora duniya se hissa ban jaati hai. Aap woh kar rahi hain, bas thak gayi hain. Thakaan se dimaag itna confuse ho jaata hai ki apni hi pehchaan pe shak hone lagta hai.

Woh pyaar jo aapko bachi ko dekhke aata hai, woh aapki asli maa hone ka saboot hai. Baaki sab thoughts... woh toh bas temporary hain, hawa ki tarah. Aapki darr se, aapki thakaan se. Aapki darr se.
